title: Supported source arrow before tensor normalization
statement:
theorem supported_source_arrow
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules Λ X)
    (d : Diagram Λ Y L) :
    d.support₂.hom ≫ (secondDiagramPushIso Λ Y L d).hom.app
        ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules Λ (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
          (source Λ Y)) =
      (pushSectionIso Λ Y).hom.app (unit Λ (ProjectiveLine Y)) ≫
        (moduleObjectDerivedPushforward Λ (secondProjection Y)).map
          (supportedUnitIso Λ Y).hom

source.place: Second identity, before precomposition by singleUnitIso.inv and tensoring.

proof.text: Expand the normalized supported source map as the single of its chosen ordinary source isomorphism followed by the canonical right-derived single comparison, then apply the derived-unit evaluation identity for the supported source.

proof_origin.place: Second identity, reduction to the canonical derived-unit evaluation.
